pattern: SELECT DISTINCT [A-Za-z\s]+ FROM [A-Za-z\s]+ AS [A-Za-z] JOIN [A-Za-z\s]+ AS [A-Za-z]_ID ON ([A-Za-z])[\.][A-Za-z]+ = [A-Za-z_ID]\.id WHERE ([A-Za-z]+)[\.][A-Za-z]+ = '.*' AND !(\(SELECT DISTINCT [A-Za-z\s]+ FROM [A-Za-z\s]+ AS [A-Za-z] JOIN [A-Za-z\s]+ AS [A-Za-z]_ID ON ([A-Za-z])[\.][A-Za-z]+ = [A-Za-z_ID]\.id\) EXCEPT SELECT [A-Za-z\s]+ FROM [A-Za-z\s]+ AS [A-Za-z]))
correction: The query should include the EXCEPT operator to exclude rows that match between the two tables, as shown in the gold SQL query.

metadata.description: This rule identifies queries where the EXCEPT operator is missing when comparing two tables.
